questions.question: Advik's birthday is on Monday 19thJune. On what day of the week will be Nishith's Birthday in the same year if Nishith was born on 17th November?
questions.solution:
Advik's birthday → 19 June, Monday

Nishith’s birthday → 17 November

So, June has the remaining → 11 Days

July → 31 Days

August → 31 Days

September → 30 Days

October → 31 Days

November → 17 Days

Total Days → 151 Days

Dividing 151 days by 7 (as there are 7 days in a week)

We get the remainder 4

Thus, 4 days ahead of Monday will be Friday which is the day on which Nishith’s birthday will fall.

Hence, the answer is Friday.

questions.question: Which National Park in Nepal is a continuation of India's Valmiki National Park?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Chitwan National Park.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Chitwan National Park:

__
 
• Chitwan National Park of Nepal is the continuation of India’s Valmiki National Park, which is located in the West Champaran District of Bihar.
 
• Located near northwestern Bihar, this national Park is an excellent example of the Terai landscape, which is characterized by swamps and marshy land.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Bandipur National Park:

__
 
• Bandipur National Park, an 874-sq.-km forested reserve in the southern Indian state of Karnataka__ is known for its small population of tigers.
 
• Once the private hunting ground of the Maharajas of Mysore, the park also harbors Indian elephants, spotted deer, gaurs (bison), antelopes, and numerous other native species.

Dudhwa National Park:

 
• Dudhwa Tiger Reserve was established in the year 1987. 
 
• It is spread over the areas of the Lakhimpur and Bahraich districts of Uttar Pradesh.
 
• Total area: 1093.79 km sq.
 
• It shares its north-eastern boundary with Nepal.
 
• It is home to 400 bird species, including cheetahs, elephants, tigers, leopards, swamp deer, etc.

Jim Corbett National Park:

 
• Jim Corbett National Park is the largest tiger reserve located in the Nainital district of Uttarakhand.
 
• It was established in the year 1936.
 
• It is famous for being home to a large number of tigers, the highest among any Indian national park.
 
• The Park itself occupies 520 square kilometers, and its whole area comprises hills, marshy depressions, riverine belts, grasslands, and a large lake.
 
• It is India's oldest and most prestigious National Park.

questions.question: Animals in which the cells are arranged in three embryonic layers are called ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Triploblastic**__.

 
 

 **Layer**
 **Characteristics**
 
 

 Triploblastic
 
 
 
• It is in the Triploblastic form of animals that the embryo is arranged in a **three-layered structure. **
 
• These layers are e**ctoderm, mesoderm, and endoderm.**
 
• Most multicellular animals are triploblastic except** sponges and coelenterates.**
 
 
 
 

 Diploblastic
 
 
 
• The term diploblastic refers to animals that have a body derived from only** two embryonic cell layers,** the ectoderm, and the endoderm.
 
• Examples of diploblastic animals are – **jellyfish, corals, sea anemone, etc. **
 
• The bodies of more complex animals are triploblastic, having developed from mesoderm as well as endoderm and ectoderm germ layers.
 
 
 
 

 Ectoderm
 
 
 
• The ectoderm is a germ layer( tissue layer), that forms in an animal embryo during development.
 
• The ectoderm is the germ layer that covers the outside of the embryo (**'ecto' meaning outside)**.
 
• The ectoderm gives rise to a number of both internal and external structures.
 
 
 
 

 Endoderm
 
 
 
• The endoderm gives rise to the **epithelium** of the pharynx, including the Eustachian tube, the tonsils, the thyroid gland, parathyroid glands, and thymus gland), the urinary bladder, the vagina (in females), and the urethra.

questions.question: If the ___________ firm has zero costs or only has fixed cost, the quantity supplied in equilibrium is given by the point where the average revenue is zero.
questions.solution: Under perfect competition, at equilibrium, price equals marginal cost. In this case when only fixed cost is there, the marginal cost will become zero and thus under equilibrium, price (that is average revenue or marginal revenue) will be equal to zero.Hence equilibrium will be at a point where price equals marginal cost which equals to zero that pertains to perfect competition firm.

questions.question: The average variable cost curve is _______ shaped.
questions.solution: In the graphical representation, Average variable cost curve is U shaped. It is so because initially the cost of variable inputs like labour is more than the return from it, and as the production goes on this cost reduces Vis a Vis its return. However, after the point, productivity goes downhill and the cost again escalate. Thus, it is for this reason that U shaped curve occurs.

questions.question: At 20% discount the selling price of an article is Rs. 2400, what is the selling price (in Rs.) if the discount is 32.5%?
questions.solution:
Given: selling price of article = Rs. 2400 and discount = 20%

⇒ Marked price = 2400/(1 - 20/100)

⇒ Marked price = 2400/0.8

⇒ Marked price = 3000

Now, discount = 32.5%

⇒ New selling price = 3000(1 - 32.5/100) = 3000(.675)

∴ New selling price = Rs. 2025

questions.question: 20% of a = b, then b% of 20 is the same as _________ of a.
questions.solution:
Given: 20% of a = b

⇒ (20/100)a = b

⇒ a = 5b

⇒b% of 20 = ____ of 5b

Let the required % be c%

⇒ (b/100)(20) = (c/100)(5b)

⇒ 20 = 5c

∴ c = 4

What is the average of all numbers between 8 and 74 which are divisible by 7?
questions.solution:
First number to be divisible by 7 in this range = 14

Last number to be divisible by 7 in this range = 70

This is an AP with difference = 7

Let the total numbers in this AP be n

⇒ Average = Sum of AP/total numbers

⇒ Average = [n/2(last term + first term)]/n

⇒ Average = (last term + first term)/2

∴ Average = (14 + 70)/2 = 42

questions.question: The slope of the line AB is -2/3. The co-ordinates of points A and B are (x, -3) and (5, 2) respectively. What is the value of x?
questions.solution:
Slope of a line joining 2 points (x₁, y₁) and (x₂, y₂) is (y₂ - y₁)/(x₂ - x₁).

So, -2/3 = [2 - (-3)]/(5 - x)

⇒ -2/3 = 5/(5 - x)

⇒ -10 + 2x = 15

∴ x = 25/2 = 12.5

questions.question: What is the reflection of the point (4, 7) in the line y = -1?
questions.solution:
To find: reflection of the point (4, 7) in the line y = -1

The equation of line is: y + 1 = 0

The formula for finding the image of a point (x₁, y₁) to the line ax + by + c = 0 is given by:

(x - x₁)/a = (y - y₁)/b = -2(ax₁ + by₁ + c)/(a² + b²)

Here, a = 0, b = 1 and c = 1

So, we have

(x - 4) = 0 and (y - 7) = -2(7 + 1)/1

⇒ x = 4 and y = -16 + 7

∴ y = -9

questions.question: The 3rd and 7th term of an arithmetic progression are -9 and 11 respectively. What is the 15th term?
questions.solution:
Let the first term be a and the difference be d

⇒ a + (3 - 1)d = -9

⇒ a + 2d = -9 ----(i)

Similarly, a + 6d = 11 ----(ii)

Subtracting (i) from (ii)

⇒ 4d = 11 - (-9) = 20

⇒ d = 5

Putting d = 5 in (i), we get

⇒ a + 10 = -9

⇒ a = -19

∴ 15th term = a + 14d = -19 + 14 × 5 = 51
